text: I feel as if I'm traversing a space dedicated to thought and innovation, perhaps an office or a museum of ideas. My movement from the quiet, glass-encased meeting room to the vibrant display labeled 'R+D' makes me ponder the journey of ideas from conception to realization. Here in this curated environment, surrounded by the tangible echoes of research and development, I feel both inspired and slightly disoriented by the slanted angles and artificial lighting, as if the world itself is asking me to see things differently.
